prompt:
A young adult East Asian woman walking in a narrow alley of a Greek island-style white village, in a full-body composition. The subject is slightly to the right of center, body facing right, captured mid-stride: the front leg is extended far to the right, the back leg naturally pushing off the ground, steps powerful and following realistic gravity. Upper body upright, shoulders relaxed, arms hanging naturally and swinging slightly with the pace. Head slightly raised and turned towards the top right of the frame, looking into the distance, not looking at the camera, with a calm, confident, and restrained expression, possessing a high-fashion model aura.

She has a refined oval face, almond-shaped deep brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender bridge of the nose, and low-saturation nude red lips. Makeup is exquisite but light, skin tone is fair and warm, preserving real pores, fine vellus hair, natural skin tone variations, and sunlight highlights, no plastic airbrushing. Deep brown-black long hair flowing naturally with soft waves, blown to the left side of the frame by the sea breeze, clear hair edges, with a few stray hairs across the cheek. Wearing small gold earrings.

She is wearing a high-saturation cobalt blue haute couture short dress, with a high stand collar, sleeveless, slim waistline, and a three-dimensional asymmetric wrap skirt structure; a very long, large trailing cape is attached to the back of the skirt, made of thick silk satin or high-grade matte crepe satin, spreading out largely to the left with the wind, forming a strong dynamic curve. On her feet are matching cobalt blue pointed-toe stiletto slingbacks with slender metal heels.

The environment is Mykonos-style architecture: pure white lime walls, narrow alleys, white stone steps, deep cobalt blue doors and windows, blue outdoor stairs, and wooden beams. The sky is pure deep blue, and the ground is irregular light gray-white flagstone. Uses strong noon Mediterranean sunlight from the upper left, forming clear hard shadows, high-contrast white walls, and saturated blue layers, with dry and clear air.

Photography style: 28mm or 35mm wide-angle lens, low angle slightly shooting upwards, lens height about knee level, f/5.6, medium deep depth of field, both subject and architecture are clear, realistic wide-angle perspective, accurate leg proportions, real fabric physical movement, slight ISO 100 grain, high-end Vogue Mediterranean fashion advertisement, photorealistic.

promptZh:
一位年轻的东亚女性走在希腊岛屿风格的白色村庄狭窄巷弄中，全身构图。主体位于画面中心偏右，身体朝向右侧，捕捉迈步瞬间：前腿大幅向右延伸，后腿自然蹬地，步伐有力且符合真实重力。上身挺拔，双肩放松，双臂自然下垂并随步伐轻微摆动。头部微抬，转向画面右上角望向远方，未注视镜头，神情冷静、自信且内敛，具备高级时装模特的气质。

她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸、杏仁状深棕色双眸、自然的细眉、纤细的鼻梁以及低饱和度的裸红色双唇。妆容精致但清透，肤色白皙且温暖，保留了真实的毛孔、细微绒毛、自然的肤色变化以及阳光高光，无塑料感磨皮。深棕黑色长发随海风向画面左侧自然飘动，发丝边缘清晰，几缕发丝拂过脸颊。佩戴着小巧的金色耳环。

她身着高饱和度钴蓝色高级定制短裙，高立领、无袖、收腰设计，配有立体不对称裹裙结构；裙后连着一件超长的大型拖地斗篷，由厚实的丝绸缎面或高级哑光绉缎制成，随风向左大幅铺开，形成强烈的动态曲线。脚穿同色系钴蓝色尖头细跟露跟鞋，配有纤细的金属鞋跟。

环境为米科诺斯风格建筑：纯白石灰墙、狭窄巷弄、白色石阶、深钴蓝色门窗、蓝色户外楼梯以及木梁。天空呈现纯净的深蓝色，地面为不规则的浅灰白色石板路。采用左上方强烈的地中海正午阳光，形成清晰的硬朗阴影，白墙与饱和的蓝色层次形成高对比度，空气干燥清澈。

摄影风格：28mm 或 35mm 广角镜头，低角度微仰拍，镜头高度约在膝盖位置，f/5.6 光圈，中等景深，主体与建筑均清晰可见，真实的广角透视，准确的腿部比例，真实的织物物理运动，轻微的 ISO 100 颗粒感，高端 Vogue 地中海时尚广告质感，照片级真实。
